name: winter_rapeseed

source.t_base_c: [AS] base temperature 0 degC; canola AquaCrop calibrations use 0-5 degC, not confirmed.

source.stages: [D] emergence 216, rosette 558, buds 1755, flowering 1942, maturity 3267, overripe 3504 are development units accumulated by the Python port of the model's thermal-time rule (clamped daily Tmin/Tmax, Tbase/Tupper above) along the Frankfurt/Main daily record (DWD station 01420), 1992-2024, from the year's mean sowing date to the year's mean date of the DWD phase (annual reporters of all German stations, quality level <= 3; DWD CDC opendata phenology/annual_reporters/crops), averaged over 32 seasons (DWD winter rapeseed phases 12 Auflaufen BBCH 10, 14 Rosettenbildung BBCH 14, 17 Knospenbildung BBCH 50, 5 Bluete Beginn BBCH 61, 22 Vollreife BBCH 87, 24 Ernte; sd 28/52/95/91/111/122 units; mean doys sowing 237.4 (25 Aug), emergence 249.5, rosette 271.9, buds 98.9, flowering 115.9, full ripe 193.8, harvest 205.6). Senescence 2450 [AS]: start of the canopy decline between the end of flowering and maturity.

source.cc0_cm2_per_plant: [AS] canopy per rapeseed seedling at emergence (larger cotyledons than a cereal); not confirmed in a canola calibration.
source.plant_density_per_ha: [AS] 40-50 established plants/m2 in autumn (German practice, 40-60 seeds/m2); 4.5e5/ha.
source.senescence_acceleration: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: extra senescence progress per unit of senescence stress (1 - Ks_sen); the model's own device (AquaCrop shifts the senescence start instead).)

source.kc_tr_x: [AS] transpiration coefficient at full canopy; FAO-56 Table 12 gives a single Kc,mid of 1.0-1.15 for rapeseed/canola.
source.height_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 12 (fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm): rapeseed/canola maximum crop height 0.6 m.
source.p_depletion: [C] FAO-56 Table 22 (fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm): rapeseed/canola p = 0.60 at ETc ~ 5 mm/day, rooting depth 1.0-1.5 m.
source.p_adjust_for_etc: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: FAO-56 Table 22 note: p = p_table + 0.04 (5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8 (the limits are in the code as the note's own range).)
source.exp_p_upper: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: canopy expansion, 0.20 (the annex labels it 'pexp,lower ... Upper threshold').)
source.exp_p_lower: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: canopy expansion, 0.65.)
source.exp_shape: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: shape factor for canopy expansion 5.0.)
source.sen_p_upper: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: canopy senescence psen 0.70.)
source.sen_shape: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: shape factor for canopy senescence 2.5.)

source.wp_star_g_m2: [AS] normalised water productivity of canola: 15.3 g/m2 (spring canola, Karkag, calibrated) and 18.6 g/m2 (Wagga Wagga, Zeleke et al. 2011, Agron. J. 103:1610-1618) as found in search-result snippets; 17.0 between them. With the light-primary form WP* does not drive the gain, it enters only the CO2 type (f_type 1).
source.rue_g_mj: [M] 0.9 g/MJ of global radiation for rapeseed, set so that the 30-year mean on the home loess is about 8 %% above the Destatis 2016/21 national mean (33.6 dt/ha; 1.0 gave +22 %%), the site being favourable like the wheat site (+5 %%); the literature value of rapeseed RUE was not looked up.
source.rue_t_low_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: ramp of the light-use efficiency over the daily mean air temperature: 0 at and below this value, 1 at rue_t_full_c. Form: linear ramp as in the SIMPLE crop model (Zhao et al. 2019, Eur. J. Agron. 104:97-106; read in a code port, not the paper). Both values fitted (F1d part 1) so that the aboveground biomass at BBCH 31 falls from 6.7 t/ha to about 4 t/ha without the harvest falling by more than 15 )
source.rue_t_full_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: see rue_t_low_c.)
source.light_primary: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: 1: the daily gain is the light potential x Tr/Tr_potential (the water factor of the AquaCrop gain, Tr = transpiration, Tr_potential = Kcb x ET0), WP* is then not used for the gain. 0: the smaller of the light potential and WP* x Tr/ET0. With 0 and the ramp below the harvest was 14 % under the DESTATIS mean at the same BBCH 31 biomass (F1d part 1); with 1 the same early biomass keeps the yield, bec)
source.co2_response: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), chapter 3, Table 3.11c/1 (Eq. 3.11c): multiplier of WP* for a C3 crop (f_type = 1) over the atmospheric CO2 concentration, the FACE-based column (fsink 0); WP* is normalised to 369.41 ppm (the year 2000). Applied to WP* and, as photosynthesis, to rue. The crop's f_type = clamp((40 - WP*)/20, 0, 1) (Eq. 3.11d).)

source.hi0: [AS] reference harvest index 0.30: a semi-arid canola AquaCrop study reports HI0 = 30 %% (search-result snippet); Bas22 straw ratio 1.7 gives 0.38 for the harvested grain/straw split.
source.hi_build_gdd: [D] development units from the flowering stage to maturity of the stage table (3267 - 1942).
source.flowering_length_gdd: [AS] flowering of rapeseed lasts about 4 weeks (about 300 units at 11 units/day in April-May).
source.excess_fruits_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 3.2 lists 'medium' without a number; 50 % is the value of the manual's own worked example (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, Fig. 3.12i).)
source.ppol: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: pollination fails above a depletion of 0.85 of TAW (estimate); Ks_pol,w falls linearly to 0 at TAW (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12).)
source.sto_coefficient_b: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: coefficient b of the negative effect of stomatal closure during yield formation (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, Eq. 3.12m/n: 1 = strong effect .. 20 = small effect); Annex I.10 section 3.2 gives only 'moderate' for wheat. 7 (recalled default crop file) is inside the range. The functional form (HI factor = mean of 1 - (1 - Ks_sto^(1/10))/b) is [C];)
source.cold_t_c: [AS] minimum temperature below which pollination starts to fail.
source.cold_width_k: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, section 3.12.5: cold pollination coefficient reaches 0 five degrees below the threshold.)
source.heat_t_c: [AS] maximum temperature above which pollination starts to fail (B. napus is heat-sensitive from about 29.5 degC at flowering, recalled).
source.heat_width_k: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, section 3.12.5: heat pollination coefficient reaches 0 five degrees above the threshold (F1a had a 6 K width).)
source.logistic_steepness: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the manual says the temperature Ks curves are logistic (section 3.2.3) but prints no equation; this is the steepness of a logistic rescaled to hit 0 and 1 at the limits.)
source.straw_harvest_fraction: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: winter rapeseed straw:grain 1.7 (86 % / 91 % dry matter) = 1.46 t straw dm per t grain fresh (0.91 t dm) = 1.6 per t grain dm; 1.6 x 0.30 = 0.48 of the biomass out of the non-grain 0.70: 0.69.

source.zr_min_m: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 1.4: minimum effective rooting depth 0.30 m.)
source.zr_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 22: rapeseed/canola maximum rooting depth 1.0-1.5 m (middle).
source.gdd_full: [AS] development units from sowing at which the maximum depth is reached (before maturity).

source.kill_onset_c: [AS] daily minimum at which frost starts to kill an emerged rosette (winter rapeseed LT50 about -15 to -20 degC, recalled).
source.kill_full_c: [AS] daily minimum at which the whole stand is killed.
source.snow_insulation_swe_mm: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: snow water equivalent above which snow shields the stand.)
source.snow_floor_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: lowest temperature the stand sees under that snow.)

source.harvest_window_days: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: days after maturity before the grain starts to shed.)
source.shed_rate_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: fraction of the remaining grain lost per day afterwards.)

source.nc_a: [AS] Colnenne, Meynard, Reau, Justes, Merrien 1998 (Ann. Bot. 81:311-317) critical N curve of winter oilseed rape, Nc = 4.5 W^-0.25 recalled; the abstract found this session confirms the paper but not the coefficients.
source.nc_w_min_t_ha: [AS] below 1 t/ha the curve is held at its value for 1 t/ha.
source.n_min_conc_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: N concentration at which growth stops.)
source.n_stress_start_t_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the N factor applies once the aboveground dry matter exceeds this.)
source.n_uptake_max_kg_ha_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: maximum daily N uptake.)
source.n_uptake_frac_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the available soil mineral N the roots can take per day.)
source.n_residual_kg_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: soil mineral N the roots cannot take.)
source.n_root_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: root N as a fraction of the aboveground N.)
source.n_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: Winterraps grain (91 % dry matter) 3.35 kg N/dt, straw 0.70 kg/dt, straw ratio 1.7 dt/dt.
source.n_fixation_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: cereals do not fix nitrogen.)
source.p2o5_conc_pct_dm: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: total aboveground P2O5 per t fresh grain over the aboveground dry matter 0.91/0.30 t.
source.p2o5_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: grain 1.80, straw 0.40 kg P2O5/dt.
source.k2o_conc_pct_dm: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: as p2o5_conc_pct_dm for K2O.
source.k2o_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: grain 1.00, straw 2.35 kg K2O/dt.
source.ph_opt_low: [AS] pH (CaCl2) from which rapeseed is unrestricted; rapeseed is lime-demanding (VDLUFA target for heavy soils above 6, recalled).
source.ph_opt_high: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )
source.ph_floor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: pH at which the factor is ph_floor_factor.)
source.ph_floor_factor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )
source.lodging_nmin_start_kg_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: soil mineral N in the root zone above which lodging starts to cost yield.)
source.lodging_nmin_full_kg_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: ... and at which the loss is lodging_max_loss.)
source.lodging_max_loss: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the grain lost at the full lodging risk.)
source.lodging_bbch_from: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: window of the stem elongation to flowering stages in which surplus N makes the stand lodge.)
source.lodging_bbch_to: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )

source.root_dm_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: root dry matter as a share of the aboveground dry matter at harvest; cereal root:shoot at maturity is about 0.1-0.2 (recalled).)
source.root_upper_share: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the root residue in the top 0.10 m of the 0.30 m management layers.)
source.seed_mass_g: [D] thousand-seed weight 5 g of winter rapeseed (4.5-6 g).
source.seed_viability: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: germination capacity of drilled seed (the German seed law minimum is 85 %, certified lots are above 92 %).)
source.depth_opt_min_m: [AS] drilling depth of rapeseed 1-2 cm (extension advice, recalled).
source.depth_zero_m: [AS] emergence fails from about 5 cm for the small seed.
source.depth_surface_factor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence of seed lying on the surface (birds, drying) relative to the optimum depth.)
source.seedbed_floor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence factor of the worst seedbed; field emergence of drilled wheat is typically 75-85 % of the seeds, which this reproduces together with seed_viability.)
source.residue_emergence_penalty: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence lost at full residue cover for a tool with residue_tolerance 0.)
source.germ_wet_min: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: wetness of the evaporation layer (1 - De/TEW) below which the seed does not germinate.)
source.germ_wet_full: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: wetness from which germination runs at full rate.)
source.dry_hazard_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the sown seed that dies per day in a seed layer below germ_wet_min.)
source.compensation_density_m2: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_rapeseed, not crop-specific (wheat entry: constant d0 of the yield-density law 1 - exp(-d/d0) (Willey and Heath 1969 form); wheat compensates thin stands by tillering, 100 plants/m2 give about 92 % of the 250 plants/m2 reference.)

source: F1d winter rapeseed (family brassica). AquaCrop has no rapeseed in Annex I; parameters come from the canola AquaCrop calibrations named in each entry (values read from search-result snippets, not from the papers) and FAO-56. The stage table is [D] from DWD phenology and the Frankfurt station. Nutrient removal is [D] from LfL Bayern Bas22. No vernalisation is modelled (autumn sowing only).
